scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.unified:build: npm run build:backend --prefix server && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL= NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL= npm run build --prefix client && npm run unified:start --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
